name: Hugging Face Static Spaces
free_limit: Free static HTML/JavaScript Spaces hosted on Hugging Face for demos, portfolios and ML interfaces, without managed runtime compute
watch_out: Static Spaces are free for everyone. Creating CPU-backed Gradio/Docker compute Spaces normally requires a paid account tier, even though CPU Basic hardware itself lists a zero hourly rate; limited eligible ZeroGPU exceptions exist. GPUs, model inference and persistent compute are not part of this static tier.
